decisions.summary: Wave 42 takes row 492 (the end-nub cut, E2) while rows 482-491 (ten open, kept, unflagged E2 rows in ways/, no recorded dependency) wait for the next wave; the plan calls this 'in ranking order'
decisions.why: FR-006 makes each wave 'a contiguous run of the ranking' and Key Entities defines a wave the same way; SC-003 lets a row wait only on a dependency recorded in the ranking, and none of 482-491 records one (after: [] on all but 486/490/491, whose afters are other rows, not 492). Amendment 40 round 2 asked the next wave to return to ranking order; 481 + 492 is not a contiguous run, and the plan's 'in ranking order' is untrue for 492. Nothing makes 482-491 first impossible, the GM's words do not imply skipping them, and the literal order defeats no purpose. Fix: take 482-491 before or with 492, or hold 492 to its turn, or record in the ranking the measured reason a skipped row cannot be fixed now.
